boundary: The bounded compact HiGHS run returned UNKNOWN with no primal solution. The packet neither proves nor disproves chi(H)=9.

exact_cover_model.equivalence: A 9-colouring of the frame-intersection graph is equivalent to assigning one colour to every frame so that each of the 240 nine-frame edge cliques contains every colour exactly once.

symmetry_breaking.conclusion: The 15-frame ABI anchor signature is a complete S6 orbit key for the frozen feasible 14-colouring, so a lex leader on this signature is nonvacuous and removes all 719 nonminimal images of that witness.

theorem: The full-rank frame-to-duad ABI supplies an invertible 15-frame anchor and, more sharply, the first two anchor frames already form a pointwise base for exceptional S6. Rewriting 9-colouring as a 240-clique exact-cover system cuts the model to 4,860 binaries, 2,700 equalities, and 24,300 nonzeros while preserving a sound geometric orbit key.
